title: The registry of the event log's families and kinds (Shared/EventKinds.json in the bridge mod)
description: One place for the vocabulary: the mod reads it to refuse a row of any other kind, the host reads it to check, merge and filter. docs/contracts/bridge-protocol.md, "The event log".

always.description: Written whatever is switched; cannot be switched off.

default.description: On when a boot starts; can be switched off.

class.description: What made the row: a player's own action, staging, or a reading of the game.

knowsPerRow.description: A row may say omniscient where the party did not perceive it.

classPerRow.description: A row may carry a class of its own: the class of the verb that made it. `class` is the class of a row that carries none.

attention.description: Its class for the attention view; begin and hold wait for an answer.

ends.description: The kind that closes a begin or hold.

payload.description: The payload's fields, each with what it holds.
